statusLine.command: jq -r '(.model.display_name // "?") as $model | (.workspace.current_dir // .cwd // "") as $dir | (env.HOME // "") as $home | (if $home != "" and ($dir | startswith($home)) then "~" + $dir[($home | length):] else $dir end) as $shortdir | (.context_window // {}) as $c | ($c.used_percentage // 0) as $p | (if $p >= 80 then "\u001b[31m" elif $p >= 50 then "\u001b[33m" else "\u001b[32m" end) as $col | "\u001b[36m\($model)\u001b[0m \u001b[35m\($shortdir)\u001b[0m \($col)ctx \($p | floor)%\u001b[0m"'
